reproduction_command: cd "$LOOM_PROJECT" && mkdir -p bin && "$LOOM_LSC" --root "$LOOM_SDK/" --project "$LOOM_PROJECT" HelloWorld.build && SDL_VIDEODRIVER=x11 SDL_AUDIODRIVER=dummy LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1 xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 640x480x24 -nolisten tcp' timeout --kill-after=3s 8s stdbuf -oL -eL "$LOOM_PLAYER" "$LOOM_PROJECT/bin/Main.loom"
semantic_scope: The pinned LoomScript compiler built Main.loom from the unchanged HelloWorld.ls and the recorded project fixture. The native LoomPlayer ran the resulting assembly in an isolated Xvfb display. HelloWorld.run printed the exact line `Hello, World!`. The application loop was stopped after eight seconds by the test timeout, which returned 124. The log also records unavailable audio and failed connection attempts to the optional localhost asset server.
